          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency,
        scd.last_update
      FROM performance /* scd_performance_bottom_up:
    * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    */.scd_performance_bottom_up AS scd
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE time_weighted_return_4yp_lc END AS time_weighted_return_4yp_lc, /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE pnl_4yp_lc END AS pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf
        ON scd.business_date = CAST(perf.business_date AS VARCHAR)
        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')
            AND scd.split_level = 2
            AND scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
          )
        )
    ) AS scd_perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS scd_perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), perf AS (
    SELECT
      dataset_id,
      business_date,
      CASE
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D'
        THEN 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'
        THEN 'Total Fund Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        THEN 'Base CPP Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'

      CASE

        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'
        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        dataset_id,

        time_weighted_return_rc AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_lc AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,

        time_weighted_return_fytd_rc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,

        time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        pnl_rc AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM scd_perf
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM perf
  ), cmb_clean AS (
    SELECT
      cmb.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      CASE
        WHEN "period" = '1D'
        THEN '1. 1-Day'
        WHEN "period" = 'MTD'
        THEN '2. MTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'QTD'
        THEN '3. QTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'FYTD'
        THEN '4. FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '4Y+FYTD'
        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
WHERE
  "business_date" > FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(1748126735612 AS VARCHAR), 1, 10) AS BIGINT))

          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_local_currency
        END AS pnl_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency,
        scd.last_update
      FROM performance /* scd_performance_bottom_up:
    * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    */.scd_performance_bottom_up AS scd
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE time_weighted_return_4yp_lc END AS time_weighted_return_4yp_lc, /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE pnl_4yp_lc END AS pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf
        ON scd.business_date = CAST(perf.business_date AS VARCHAR)
        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')
            AND scd.split_level = 2
            AND scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
          )
        )
    ) AS scd_perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS scd_perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), perf AS (
    SELECT
      dataset_id,
      business_date,
      CASE
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D'
        THEN 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'
        THEN 'Total Fund Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        THEN 'Base CPP Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'
      END AS currency,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'
        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'
        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        dataset_id,
        business_date,
        node_name AS pbor_node_name,
        "level" AS split_level,
        time_weighted_return_rc AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_lc AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_rc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_lc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_rc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_lc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        pnl_rc AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM scd_perf
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM perf
  ), cmb_clean AS (
    SELECT
      cmb.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      CASE
        WHEN "period" = '1D'
        THEN '1. 1-Day'
        WHEN "period" = 'MTD'
        THEN '2. MTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'QTD'
        THEN '3. QTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'FYTD'
        THEN '4. FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '4Y+FYTD'
        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
WHERE
  "business_date" > FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(1748126735612 AS VARCHAR), 1, 10) AS BIGINT))

          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_local_currency
        END AS pnl_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency,
        scd.last_update
      FROM performance /* scd_performance_bottom_up:
    * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    */.scd_performance_bottom_up AS scd
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE time_weighted_return_4yp_lc END AS time_weighted_return_4yp_lc, /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE pnl_4yp_lc END AS pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf
        ON scd.business_date = CAST(perf.business_date AS VARCHAR)
        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')
            AND scd.split_level = 2
            AND scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
          )
        )
    ) AS scd_perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS scd_perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), perf AS (
    SELECT
      dataset_id,
      business_date,
      CASE
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D'
        THEN 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'
        THEN 'Total Fund Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        THEN 'Base CPP Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'
      END AS currency,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'
        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'
        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        dataset_id,
        business_date,
        node_name AS pbor_node_name,
        "level" AS split_level,
        time_weighted_return_rc AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_lc AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_rc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_lc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_rc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_lc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        pnl_rc AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM scd_perf
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM perf
  ), cmb_clean AS (
    SELECT
      cmb.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      CASE
        WHEN "period" = '1D'
        THEN '1. 1-Day'
        WHEN "period" = 'MTD'
        THEN '2. MTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'QTD'
        THEN '3. QTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'FYTD'
        THEN '4. FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '4Y+FYTD'
        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
WHERE
  "business_date" > FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(1748126735612 AS VARCHAR), 1, 10) AS BIGINT))

        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency,
        scd.last_update
      FROM performance /* scd_performance_bottom_up:
    * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    */.scd_performance_bottom_up AS scd
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE time_weighted_return_4yp_lc END AS time_weighted_return_4yp_lc, /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE pnl_4yp_lc END AS pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf
        ON scd.business_date = CAST(perf.business_date AS VARCHAR)
        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')
            AND scd.split_level = 2
            AND scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
          )
        )
    ) AS scd_perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS scd_perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), perf AS (
    SELECT
      dataset_id,
      business_date,
      CASE
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D'
        THEN 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'
        THEN 'Total Fund Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        THEN 'Base CPP Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'
      END AS currency,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'
        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'
        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        dataset_id,
        business_date,
        node_name AS pbor_node_name,
        "level" AS split_level,
        time_weighted_return_rc AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_lc AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_rc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_lc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_rc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_lc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        pnl_rc AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM scd_perf
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM perf
  ), cmb_clean AS (
    SELECT
      cmb.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      CASE
        WHEN "period" = '1D'
        THEN '1. 1-Day'
        WHEN "period" = 'MTD'
        THEN '2. MTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'QTD'
        THEN '3. QTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'FYTD'
        THEN '4. FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '4Y+FYTD'
        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
WHERE
  "business_date" > FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(1748126735612 AS VARCHAR), 1, 10) AS BIGINT))

          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE pnl_4yp_lc END AS pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf
        ON scd.business_date = CAST(perf.business_date AS VARCHAR)
        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')
            AND scd.split_level = 2
            AND scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
          )
        )
    ) AS scd_perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */

        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'

        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'

        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'

        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'

        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (

        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,

        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (

    SELECT

        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
WHERE

      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'
      END AS currency,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'
        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'
        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        scd.dataset_id,
        scd.business_date,
        scd.pbor_node_name,
        scd.split_level, /* for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used */
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_local_currency
        END AS pnl_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency,
        scd.last_update
      FROM performance /* scd_performance_bottom_up:
    * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    */.scd_performance_bottom_up AS scd
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE time_weighted_return_4yp_lc END AS time_weighted_return_4yp_lc, /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE pnl_4yp_lc END AS pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf
        ON scd.business_date = CAST(perf.business_date AS VARCHAR)
        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')
            AND scd.split_level = 2
            AND scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
          )
        )
    ) AS scd_perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS scd_perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), perf AS (
    SELECT
      dataset_id,
      business_date,
      CASE
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D'
        THEN 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'
        THEN 'Total Fund Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        THEN 'Base CPP Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'
      END AS currency,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'
        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'
        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        dataset_id,
        business_date,
        node_name AS pbor_node_name,
        "level" AS split_level,
        time_weighted_return_rc AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_lc AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_rc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_lc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_rc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_lc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        pnl_rc AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM scd_perf
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM perf
  ), cmb_clean AS (
    SELECT
      cmb.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      CASE
        WHEN "period" = '1D'
        THEN '1. 1-Day'
        WHEN "period" = 'MTD'
        THEN '2. MTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'QTD'
        THEN '3. QTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'FYTD'
        THEN '4. FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '4Y+FYTD'
        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
WHERE
  "business_date" > FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(1748126735612 AS VARCHAR), 1, 10) AS BIGINT))

  SELECT
    business_date,
    dim_hierarchy_node_id,
    node_level,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN node_level = 1
        THEN 'CPPIB-ALL'
        WHEN node_level = 2
        THEN 'DEPARTMENT'
        WHEN node_level = 3
        THEN 'STRATEGY'
        WHEN node_level = 4
        THEN 'PROGRAM'
        WHEN node_level = 5
        THEN 'SUB-PROGRAM'
        WHEN node_level = 6
        THEN 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
      END
    ) AS hierarchy_level,
    'RISK' AS HIERARCHY_TYPE,
    node_name,
    '' AS account,
    '' AS pool,
    parent_node_id,
    investment_dept,
    investment_strat,
    program,
    sub_program,
    model_portfolio
  FROM radar_reporting_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk
  WHERE
    business_date = '2025-05-22'
), classification_secno AS (
  SELECT
    inst_id,
    industry_sector_name
  FROM asset.asset_instrument_classifications_latest AS class
  JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_inst AS i
    ON i.security_number = class.id_holding_decomposition
    AND i.business_date = CAST(class.business_date AS VARCHAR)
  WHERE
    i.business_date = '2025-05-22'
    AND class.holding_decomposition_id_type_code = 'SECURITY_NO'
  UNION
  SELECT
    inst_id,
    industry_sector_name
  FROM asset.asset_instrument_classifications_latest AS class
  JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_inst AS i
    ON i.cppib_security_id = class.id_holding_decomposition
    AND i.business_date = CAST(class.business_date AS VARCHAR)
  WHERE
    i.business_date = '2025-05-22'
    AND class.holding_decomposition_id_type_code = 'CPPIBSEC_ID'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  dpi.portfolio_type,
  (
    CASE
      WHEN dpi.portfolio_type IN ('IP', 'CASH_FOR_BENEFIT', 'ACPP_CFB')
      THEN dpi.pos_source_system_key
      WHEN dpi.portfolio_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH'
      THEN REPLACE(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 'CPPSECID')
      WHEN dpi.portfolio_type = 'LOOKTHROUGH'
      AND LOCATE('OFFSET', dpi.pos_source_system_key) > 0
      THEN dpi.pos_source_system_key
      ELSE CONCAT(
        SUBSTRING(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 1, LOCATE('_', dpi.pos_source_system_key) - 1),
        '_',
        dpi.pos_short_desc
      )
    END
  ) AS "position_key",
  (
    CASE
      WHEN i_rle.gics_sector IS NOT NULL
      THEN i_rle.gics_sector
      WHEN l1_rle.gics_sector IS NOT NULL
      THEN l1_rle.gics_sector
      WHEN cl.industry_sector_name IS NOT NULL
      THEN cl.industry_sector_name
      WHEN mi_rle.gics_sector IS NOT NULL
      THEN mi_rle.gics_sector
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS issuer_gics_sector,
  i_rle.gics_sector,
  l1_rle.gics_sector,
  cl.industry_sector_name,
  mi_rle.gics_sector,
  cl.inst_id AS c1_inst,
  main_inst.inst_id AS main_inst_id,
  dpi.pos_id
FROM radar_reporting_uat.fact_pos_calc_md AS dv01
JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_currency AS currency
  ON dv01.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
  AND dv01.business_date = currency.business_date
JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_term AS term
  ON dv01.dim_calc_term_id = term.dim_calc_term_id
  AND term.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'TERM'
  AND dv01.business_date = term.business_date
JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_curve AS curve
  ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_id = curve.dim_calc_curve_id
  AND curve.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'CURVE'
  AND dv01.business_date = curve.business_date
JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_curve_type AS curve_type
  ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_type_id = curve_type.dim_calc_curve_type_id
  AND curve_type.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'CURVE_TYPE'
  AND dv01.business_date = curve_type.business_date
JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_pos_inst AS dpi
  ON dv01.pos_id = dpi.pos_id
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.fact_fx_rate AS fx
  ON currency.iso_currency_code = fx.to_currency
  AND currency.chron_id = fx.chron_id
  AND fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
  AND fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
  AND dv01.business_date = fx.business_date
LEFT JOIN risk_hierarchy AS rh
  ON rh.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dv01.dim_hierarchy_node_id
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_inst AS main_inst
  ON main_inst.inst_id = dpi.inst_id
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_inst AS inst1
  ON inst1.inst_id = dpi.inst1_id
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_inst AS inst2
  ON inst2.inst_id = dpi.inst2_id
LEFT JOIN classification_secno AS cl
  ON cl.inst_id = main_inst.inst_id
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.ref_legal_entity AS i_rle
  ON i_rle.legal_entity_id = dpi.issuer_id
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.ref_legal_entity AS cp_rle
  ON cp_rle.legal_entity_id = dpi.counter_party_id
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.ref_legal_entity AS l1_rle
  ON inst1.issuer_id = l1_rle.legal_entity_id
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.ref_legal_entity AS mi_rle
  ON main_inst.issuer_id = mi_rle.legal_entity_id
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.cppib_party_rating AS cpr
  ON cpr.cppib_party_id = i_rle.cppib_party_id
  AND cpr.business_date = i_rle.business_date
LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.cppib_security_rating AS csr
  ON csr.cppib_sec_id = CAST(dpi.cppib_security_id AS INT)
  AND csr.business_date = i_rle.business_date
WHERE
  curve_type.curve_type_value = 'ZERO'
  AND dv01.calc_type = 'DV01'
  AND dv01.business_date = '2025-05-22'
  AND dv01.final_value != 0
  AND dpi.portfolio_type = 'IP'

  SELECT
    CAST('2025-05-29' AS DATE) AS input_date,
    MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
  FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation AS perf
  WHERE
    CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < CAST('2025-05-29' AS DATE)
    AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
    AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
), listed_seg_mp AS (
  SELECT
    business_date,
    model_portfolio,
    model_portfolio_name
  FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
  WHERE
    NOT model_portfolio_name LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
    AND NOT model_portfolio_name LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
    AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
    AND (
      InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
      AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
      AND NOT model_portfolio IN ('')
      OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
    )
    AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
      SELECT
        prev_trans_date
      FROM input_dates
      UNION
      SELECT
        input_date
      FROM input_dates
    )
), perf_data AS (
  SELECT
    perf.model_portfolio_id,
    perf.abor_security_id,
    perf.abor_security_number,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            prev_trans_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
      END
    ) AS market_value_qc_start,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            input_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency

    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            prev_trans_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
      END
    ) AS market_value_pc_start,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            input_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
      END

  LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets AS asset

    model_portfolio,
    model_portfolio_name
  FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
  WHERE
    NOT model_portfolio_name LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
    AND NOT model_portfolio_name LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
    AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
    AND (
      InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
      AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
      AND NOT model_portfolio IN ('')
      OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')

      SELECT
        input_date

  SELECT
    perf.model_portfolio_id,
    perf.abor_security_id,
    perf.abor_security_number,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            prev_trans_date
          FROM input_dates

        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency

    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            input_date
          FROM input_dates

        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
      END
    ) AS market_value_qc_end,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            prev_trans_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
      END

    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            input_date
          FROM input_dates
