        scd.business_date,
        scd.pbor_node_name,
        scd.split_level, /* for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used */
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_local_currency
        END AS pnl_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency,
        scd.last_update
      FROM performance /* scd_performance_bottom_up:
    * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    */.scd_performance_bottom_up AS scd
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE time_weighted_return_4yp_lc END AS time_weighted_return_4yp_lc, /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE pnl_4yp_lc END AS pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf
        ON scd.business_date = CAST(perf.business_date AS VARCHAR)
        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')
            AND scd.split_level = 2
            AND scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
          )
        )
    ) AS scd_perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS scd_perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), perf AS (
    SELECT
      dataset_id,
      business_date,
      CASE
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D'
        THEN 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'
        THEN 'Total Fund Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        THEN 'Base CPP Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'
      END AS currency,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'
        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'
        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        dataset_id,
        business_date,
        node_name AS pbor_node_name,
        "level" AS split_level,
        time_weighted_return_rc AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_lc AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_rc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_lc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_rc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_lc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        pnl_rc AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM scd_perf
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM perf
  ), cmb_clean AS (
    SELECT
      cmb.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      CASE
        WHEN "period" = '1D'
        THEN '1. 1-Day'
        WHEN "period" = 'MTD'
        THEN '2. MTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'QTD'
        THEN '3. QTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'FYTD'
        THEN '4. FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '4Y+FYTD'
        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

  * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
  * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
  * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_local_currency
        END AS pnl_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_month_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency,
        scd.last_update
      FROM performance /* scd_performance_bottom_up:
    * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    */.scd_performance_bottom_up AS scd
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE time_weighted_return_4yp_lc END AS time_weighted_return_4yp_lc, /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE pnl_4yp_lc END AS pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf
        ON scd.business_date = CAST(perf.business_date AS VARCHAR)
        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')
            AND scd.split_level = 2
            AND scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
          )
        )
    ) AS scd_perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS scd_perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), perf AS (
    SELECT
      dataset_id,
      business_date,
      CASE
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D'
        THEN 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'
        THEN 'Total Fund Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        THEN 'Base CPP Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'
      END AS currency,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'
        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'
        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        dataset_id,
        business_date,
        node_name AS pbor_node_name,
        "level" AS split_level,
        time_weighted_return_rc AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_lc AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_rc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_qtd_lc AS time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_rc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_lc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        pnl_rc AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM scd_perf
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM perf
  ), cmb_clean AS (
    SELECT
      cmb.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      CASE
        WHEN "period" = '1D'
        THEN '1. 1-Day'
        WHEN "period" = 'MTD'
        THEN '2. MTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'QTD'
        THEN '3. QTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'FYTD'
        THEN '4. FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '4Y+FYTD'
        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

        END AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        perf.pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        CASE
          WHEN scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' AND scd.split_level = 0
          THEN NULL
          ELSE scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
        END AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency,
        scd.last_update
      FROM performance /* scd_performance_bottom_up:
    * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
    */.scd_performance_bottom_up AS scd
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE time_weighted_return_4yp_lc END AS time_weighted_return_4yp_lc, /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          CASE WHEN dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' THEN NULL ELSE pnl_4yp_lc END AS pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf
        ON scd.business_date = CAST(perf.business_date AS VARCHAR)
        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')
            AND scd.split_level = 2
            AND scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
          )
        )
    ) AS scd_perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS scd_perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), perf AS (
    SELECT
      dataset_id,
      business_date,
      CASE
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D'
        THEN 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'
        THEN 'Total Fund Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        THEN 'Base CPP Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,

        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'
      END AS currency,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'
        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'

    FROM (

        time_weighted_return_fytd_rc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_lc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        pnl_rc AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM scd_perf
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM perf
  ), cmb_clean AS (
    SELECT
      cmb.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      CASE
        WHEN "period" = '1D'
        THEN '1. 1-Day'
        WHEN "period" = 'MTD'
        THEN '2. MTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'QTD'
        THEN '3. QTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'FYTD'
        THEN '4. FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '4Y+FYTD'
        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

        THEN 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'

      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'

        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'

        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'

    */

          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,

          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,
          pnl_4yp_rc,
          pnl_4yp_lc
        FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
        WHERE
          periods_per_year = 365 AND dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
      ) AS perf

        AND scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
        AND scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
        AND scd.split_level = perf."level"
      WHERE
        scd.periods_per_year = '365'
        AND (
          (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET') AND scd.split_level = 0
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP') AND scd.split_level = 0
          )
          OR /* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('ATP_TF') AND scd.split_level = 1
          )
          OR /* DEPARTMENTS */ (
            scd.dataset_id IN ('CMBP_NET')

        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE

          'ATP_ACPP_D',

          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',

      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)

  ), cmb_clean AS (

        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )

        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'

      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'

      "value"

        FROM performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly
        WHERE
          (
            dataset_id IN ('TOTALFUND_D') AND "level" = 0 AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* TOTAL FUND */
          OR /* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */ (
            dataset_id IN ('ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D')
            AND "level" = 0
            AND periods_per_year = 365
          ) /* perf_top_down_monthly:
    * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
    */
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          REPLACE(dataset_id, '_D', '') AS dataset_id,
          business_date,
          node_name,
          "level",
          time_weighted_return_4yp_rc,
          time_weighted_return_4yp_lc,

  ), perf AS (
    SELECT
      dataset_id,
      business_date,
      CASE
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D'
        THEN 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D'
        THEN 'Total Fund Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        THEN 'Base CPP Value-Added'
        WHEN dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD'
        THEN 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
        ELSE pbor_node_name
      END AS pbor_node_name,
      split_level,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE 'time_weighted_return_%'
        THEN 'Return'
        WHEN metric LIKE 'pnl_%'
        THEN 'Income'
      END AS metric_type,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_reporting_currency'
        THEN 'CAD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%_local_currency'
        THEN 'Local'
      END AS currency,
      CASE
        WHEN metric LIKE '%month_to_date%'
        THEN 'MTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%quarter_to_date%'
        THEN 'QTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%fiscal_year_to_date%'
        THEN 'FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%4year_plus%'
        THEN '4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN metric LIKE '%5year_roll%'
        THEN '5Y'
        ELSE '1D'
      END AS "period",
      "value"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        dataset_id,
        business_date,
        node_name AS pbor_node_name,
        "level" AS split_level,
        time_weighted_return_rc AS time_weighted_return_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_lc AS time_weighted_return_local_currency,

        time_weighted_return_fytd_rc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_fytd_lc AS time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_rc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_4yp_lc AS time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc AS time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency,
        pnl_rc AS pnl_reporting_currency,
        pnl_lc AS pnl_local_currency,
        pnl_qtd_rc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_qtd_lc AS pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_fytd_rc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency,
        pnl_fytd_lc AS pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency,
        pnl_4yp_rc AS pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency,
        pnl_4yp_lc AS pnl_4year_plus_local_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_rc AS pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency,
        pnl_5y_roll_lc AS pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
      FROM performance.perf_top_down_monthly
      WHERE
        dataset_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_D',
          'ATP_ACPP_D',
          'INV_SELECT_TF_D',
          'INV_SELECT_ACPPD',
          'INV_SELECT_BCPPD'
        )
        AND "level" = 1
    ) AS perf_pivot
    CROSS JOIN TABLE(
      EXPLODE(
        INPUT => ARRAY['time_weighted_return_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency', 'pnl_reporting_currency', 'pnl_local_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency', 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency', 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency', 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'] /* VALUE */
      )
    ) AS perf_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, metric, this)
  ), cmb AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM scd_perf
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      *
    FROM perf
  ), cmb_clean AS (
    SELECT
      cmb.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      CASE
        WHEN "period" = '1D'
        THEN '1. 1-Day'
        WHEN "period" = 'MTD'
        THEN '2. MTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'QTD'
        THEN '3. QTD'
        WHEN "period" = 'FYTD'

        WHEN "period" = '4Y+FYTD'
        THEN '5. 4Y+FYTD'
        WHEN "period" = '5Y'
        THEN '6. 5Y'
      END AS period_sorted
    FROM cmb
    WHERE
      "value" IS NOT NULL
      AND business_date >= CAST('2019-04-01' AS DATE)
      AND NOT (
        pbor_node_name IN ('Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing')
        AND metric_type = 'Return'
      )
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cmb_clean
) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

    AND NOT model_portfolio_name LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
    AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
    AND (
      InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
      AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
      AND NOT model_portfolio IN ('')
      OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328')
    )

      SELECT
        prev_trans_date
      FROM input_dates
      UNION
      SELECT
        input_date
      FROM input_dates
    )

  SELECT
    perf.model_portfolio_id,
    perf.abor_security_id,
    perf.abor_security_number,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            prev_trans_date

        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency

    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            input_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
      END

    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            prev_trans_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
      END

    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            input_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency

    asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
    asset.security_name,
    asset.bloomberg_code,
    mp.model_portfolio

  INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp AS mp
    ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
    AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
  LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets AS asset
    ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
    AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
    AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
  WHERE

      SELECT
        prev_trans_date
      FROM input_dates
      UNION
      SELECT
        input_date
      FROM input_dates
    )

      'Common Stock',

      'Preferred Stock',
      'REIT',
      'Unit'
    )

  AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-05-23' AS DATE)

    CAST('2025-05-20' AS DATE) AS input_date,

  FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation AS perf

    AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL

    business_date,
    model_portfolio,
    model_portfolio_name
  FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
  WHERE
    NOT model_portfolio_name LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
    AND NOT model_portfolio_name LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
    AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
    AND (
      InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
      AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
      AND NOT model_portfolio IN ('')
      OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328')
    )
    AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
      SELECT
        prev_trans_date
      FROM input_dates
      UNION
      SELECT
        input_date
      FROM input_dates
    )
), perf_data AS (
  SELECT
    perf.model_portfolio_id,
    perf.abor_security_id,
    perf.abor_security_number,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            prev_trans_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
      END
    ) AS market_value_qc_start,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            input_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
      END
    ) AS market_value_qc_end,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            prev_trans_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
      END
    ) AS market_value_pc_start,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (
          SELECT
            input_date
          FROM input_dates
        )
        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
      END
    ) AS market_value_pc_end,
    asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
    asset.security_name,
    asset.bloomberg_code,
    mp.model_portfolio
  FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation AS perf
  INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp AS mp
    ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
    AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
  LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets AS asset
    ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
    AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
    AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
  WHERE
    CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
      SELECT
        prev_trans_date
      FROM input_dates
      UNION
      SELECT
        input_date
      FROM input_dates
    )
    AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN (
      'Common Stock',
      'Depository Receipt',
      'PMI Deferred Tax Liability',
      'Preferred Stock',
      'REIT',
      'Unit'
    )
  GROUP BY
    perf.model_portfolio_id,
    perf.abor_security_id,
    perf.abor_security_number,

  AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-05-20' AS DATE)

/* cppi::96bc639a35e729fd0b5bda0b8b9f59b91966432c5df8dc5199e937c982959e69 */ /* QuickSight fb9f96ad-7033-49a7-8ae3-5fc18226cb37 */
SELECT
  "business_date",
  "pool_name",
  "account_name",
  "investment_structure_level_01",
  "investment_structure_level_02",
  "external_reporting_dm_em",
  "external_reporting_region",
  "external_reporting_country",
  "external_reporting_assetmix",
  "business_date_string",
  "year_month",
  "is_month_end",
  "is_fiscalyear_end",
  "external_reporting_dm_em_region",
  "external_reporting_currency",
  "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (
  WITH lt_base AS (
    SELECT
      mhl.business_date,
      DATE_ADD('BUSINESS_DATE', 9, 'month') AS fiscal_date,
      mhl.id_model_portfolio,
      mhl.pool_name_unified AS pool_name,
      mhl.security_name,
      mhl.total_market_value_pc,
      unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage,
      unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage,
      CASE
        WHEN mhl.pool_name_unified IN ('Core', 'Supplementary')
        THEN mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
        WHEN mhl.pool_name_unified LIKE '%bCPP%'
        THEN mhl.total_market_value_pc
      END AS bcpp_total_market_value_pc,
      CASE
        WHEN mhl.pool_name_unified IN ('Core', 'Supplementary')
        THEN mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
        WHEN mhl.pool_name_unified LIKE '%aCPP%'
        THEN mhl.total_market_value_pc
      END AS acpp_total_market_value_pc,
      mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code,
      mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name,
      mhl.currency_of_exposure_code,
      mhl.currency_of_exposure_name,
      mhl.country_of_exposure_code,
      mhl.country_of_exposure_name,
      mhl.parent_security_number,
      mhl.external_reporting_dm_em,
      mhl.external_reporting_region,
      mhl.external_reporting_country,
      mhl.external_reporting_assetmix,
      spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 AS investment_structure_level_01,
      spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 AS investment_structure_level_02
    FROM (
      SELECT
        *,
        CASE
          WHEN pool_name IN ('Core', 'Core Pool')
          THEN 'Core'
          WHEN pool_name IN ('Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool')
          THEN 'Supplementary'
          ELSE pool_name
        END AS pool_name_unified /* per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix */
      FROM holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
    ) AS mhl /* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        *
      FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
      WHERE
        investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND business_date = (
          SELECT
            MAX(business_date)
          FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        )
    ) AS spif
      ON mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio /* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        business_date,
        CASE
          WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE'
          THEN 'Core'
          WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP'
          THEN 'Supplementary'
        END AS pool_name,
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' AND acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP'
            THEN unitized_percentage
            WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP'
            THEN 0
          END
        ) AS bcpp_unitized_percentage,
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' AND acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP'
            THEN unitized_percentage
            WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP'
            THEN 1
          END
        ) AS acpp_unitized_percentage
      FROM (
        SELECT
          unitization.*
        FROM (
          SELECT
            business_date,
            MAX(extract_time) AS latest_extract_time /* select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only */
          FROM finance_accounting.scd_unitization
          GROUP BY
            business_date
        ) AS dates
        LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT /* select distinct records only in case there are duplicates */
            business_date,
            extract_time,
            acpp_bcpp_account_code,
            unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
            unitized_percentage
          FROM finance_accounting.scd_unitization
        ) AS unitization
          ON dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
          AND dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
      )
      WHERE
        unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code IN ('CORE', 'SUPP')
      GROUP BY
        business_date,
        unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
    ) AS unitization
      ON mhl.business_date = CAST(unitization.business_date AS DATE)
      AND mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
    WHERE
      mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' /* temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug */
      AND NOT mhl.id_model_portfolio IN (
        'MIN1000042',
        'NPTESTA',
        'NPTESTB',
        'PMIEMELTCS',
        'PMIEMFLTCL',
        'PMIEMFLTPA',
        'PMIEMFLTVA'
      )
      AND mhl.business_date >= CAST('2019-03-31' AS DATE) /* only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01 */
  ), lt_final AS (
    SELECT
      lt_base.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      FORMAT('%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date) AS year_month,
      CASE
        WHEN business_date = (
          MAX(business_date) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date))
        )
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
      END AS is_month_end,
      CASE
        WHEN fiscal_date = (
          MAX(fiscal_date) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fiscal_date))
        )
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
      END AS is_fiscalyear_end,
      CASE
        WHEN external_reporting_country IN ('CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO')
        THEN 'Greater China'
        WHEN external_reporting_country = 'INDIA'
        THEN 'India'
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM'
        AND external_reporting_region IN ('United States', 'Canada')
        THEN external_reporting_region
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' AND external_reporting_region = 'Europe'
        THEN 'DM Europe'
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM'
        THEN 'Other DM'
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM'
        AND external_reporting_region IN ('Latin America')
        THEN external_reporting_region
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM'
        THEN 'Other EM'
      END AS external_reporting_dm_em_region,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code) IN ('USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL')
        THEN COALESCE(currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code)
        ELSE 'Other'
      END AS external_reporting_currency /* temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product */
    FROM lt_base
  ), lt_final_agg AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM (
      SELECT
        lt_agg.business_date, /* , lt_agg.fiscal_date */
        lt_agg.pool_name,
        lt_agg_unpivot.account_name,
        lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01,
        lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_region,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_country,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix,
        lt_agg.business_date_string,
        lt_agg.year_month,
        lt_agg.is_month_end,
        lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_currency, /* , lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig */
        lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
      FROM (
        SELECT
          business_date, /* , fiscal_date */
          pool_name,
          investment_structure_level_01,
          investment_structure_level_02,
          external_reporting_dm_em,
          external_reporting_region,
          external_reporting_country,
          external_reporting_assetmix,
          business_date_string,
          year_month,
          is_month_end,
          is_fiscalyear_end,
          external_reporting_dm_em_region,
          external_reporting_currency,
          SUM(total_market_value_pc) AS total_market_value_pc,
          SUM(bcpp_total_market_value_pc) AS bcpp_total_market_value_pc,
          SUM(acpp_total_market_value_pc) AS acpp_total_market_value_pc
        FROM lt_final
        GROUP BY
          business_date, /* , fiscal_date */
          pool_name,
          investment_structure_level_01,
          investment_structure_level_02,
          external_reporting_dm_em,
          external_reporting_region,
          external_reporting_country,
          external_reporting_assetmix,
          business_date_string,
          year_month,
          is_month_end,
          is_fiscalyear_end,
          external_reporting_dm_em_region,
          external_reporting_currency
      ) AS lt_agg
      CROSS JOIN TABLE(EXPLODE(INPUT => ARRAY['bCPP', 'aCPP'])) AS lt_agg_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, account_name, this)
    )
    WHERE
      total_market_value_pc IS NOT NULL AND total_market_value_pc != 0
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM lt_final_agg
) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

SELECT
  "business_date",
  "pool_name",
  "account_name",
  "investment_structure_level_01",
  "investment_structure_level_02",
  "external_reporting_dm_em",
  "external_reporting_region",
  "external_reporting_country",
  "external_reporting_assetmix",
  "business_date_string",
  "year_month",
  "is_month_end",
  "is_fiscalyear_end",
  "external_reporting_dm_em_region",
  "external_reporting_currency",
  "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (
  WITH lt_base AS (
    SELECT
      mhl.business_date,
      DATE_ADD('BUSINESS_DATE', 9, 'month') AS fiscal_date,
      mhl.id_model_portfolio,
      mhl.pool_name_unified AS pool_name,
      mhl.security_name,
      mhl.total_market_value_pc,
      unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage,
      unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage,
      CASE
        WHEN mhl.pool_name_unified IN ('Core', 'Supplementary')
        THEN mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
        WHEN mhl.pool_name_unified LIKE '%bCPP%'
        THEN mhl.total_market_value_pc
      END AS bcpp_total_market_value_pc,
      CASE
        WHEN mhl.pool_name_unified IN ('Core', 'Supplementary')
        THEN mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
        WHEN mhl.pool_name_unified LIKE '%aCPP%'
        THEN mhl.total_market_value_pc
      END AS acpp_total_market_value_pc,
      mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code,
      mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name,
      mhl.currency_of_exposure_code,
      mhl.currency_of_exposure_name,
      mhl.country_of_exposure_code,
      mhl.country_of_exposure_name,
      mhl.parent_security_number,
      mhl.external_reporting_dm_em,
      mhl.external_reporting_region,
      mhl.external_reporting_country,
      mhl.external_reporting_assetmix,
      spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 AS investment_structure_level_01,
      spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 AS investment_structure_level_02
    FROM (
      SELECT
        *,
        CASE
          WHEN pool_name IN ('Core', 'Core Pool')
          THEN 'Core'
          WHEN pool_name IN ('Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool')
          THEN 'Supplementary'
          ELSE pool_name
        END AS pool_name_unified /* per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix */
      FROM holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
    ) AS mhl /* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        *
      FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
      WHERE
        investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND business_date = (
          SELECT
            MAX(business_date)
          FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        )
    ) AS spif
      ON mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio /* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        business_date,
        CASE
          WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE'
          THEN 'Core'
          WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP'
          THEN 'Supplementary'
        END AS pool_name,
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' AND acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP'
            THEN unitized_percentage
            WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP'
            THEN 0
          END
        ) AS bcpp_unitized_percentage,
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' AND acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP'
            THEN unitized_percentage
            WHEN unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP'
            THEN 1
          END
        ) AS acpp_unitized_percentage
      FROM (
        SELECT
          unitization.*
        FROM (
          SELECT
            business_date,
            MAX(extract_time) AS latest_extract_time /* select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only */
          FROM finance_accounting.scd_unitization
          GROUP BY
            business_date
        ) AS dates
        LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT DISTINCT /* select distinct records only in case there are duplicates */
            business_date,
            extract_time,
            acpp_bcpp_account_code,
            unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
            unitized_percentage
          FROM finance_accounting.scd_unitization
        ) AS unitization
          ON dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
          AND dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
      )
      WHERE
        unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code IN ('CORE', 'SUPP')
      GROUP BY
        business_date,
        unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
    ) AS unitization
      ON mhl.business_date = CAST(unitization.business_date AS DATE)
      AND mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
    WHERE
      mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' /* temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug */
      AND NOT mhl.id_model_portfolio IN (
        'MIN1000042',
        'NPTESTA',
        'NPTESTB',
        'PMIEMELTCS',
        'PMIEMFLTCL',
        'PMIEMFLTPA',
        'PMIEMFLTVA'
      )
      AND mhl.business_date >= CAST('2019-03-31' AS DATE) /* only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01 */
  ), lt_final AS (
    SELECT
      lt_base.*,
      CAST(business_date AS VARCHAR) AS business_date_string,
      FORMAT('%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date) AS year_month,
      CASE
        WHEN business_date = (
          MAX(business_date) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date))
        )
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
      END AS is_month_end,
      CASE
        WHEN fiscal_date = (
          MAX(fiscal_date) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fiscal_date))
        )
        THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
      END AS is_fiscalyear_end,
      CASE
        WHEN external_reporting_country IN ('CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO')
        THEN 'Greater China'
        WHEN external_reporting_country = 'INDIA'
        THEN 'India'
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM'
        AND external_reporting_region IN ('United States', 'Canada')
        THEN external_reporting_region
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' AND external_reporting_region = 'Europe'
        THEN 'DM Europe'
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM'
        THEN 'Other DM'
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM'
        AND external_reporting_region IN ('Latin America')
        THEN external_reporting_region
        WHEN external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM'
        THEN 'Other EM'
      END AS external_reporting_dm_em_region,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code) IN ('USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL')
        THEN COALESCE(currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code)
        ELSE 'Other'
      END AS external_reporting_currency /* temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product */
    FROM lt_base
  ), lt_final_agg AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM (
      SELECT
        lt_agg.business_date, /* , lt_agg.fiscal_date */
        lt_agg.pool_name,
        lt_agg_unpivot.account_name,
        lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01,
        lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_region,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_country,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix,
        lt_agg.business_date_string,
        lt_agg.year_month,
        lt_agg.is_month_end,
        lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region,
        lt_agg.external_reporting_currency, /* , lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig */
        lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
      FROM (
        SELECT
          business_date, /* , fiscal_date */
          pool_name,
          investment_structure_level_01,
          investment_structure_level_02,
          external_reporting_dm_em,
          external_reporting_region,
          external_reporting_country,
          external_reporting_assetmix,
          business_date_string,
          year_month,
          is_month_end,
          is_fiscalyear_end,
          external_reporting_dm_em_region,
          external_reporting_currency,
          SUM(total_market_value_pc) AS total_market_value_pc,
          SUM(bcpp_total_market_value_pc) AS bcpp_total_market_value_pc,
          SUM(acpp_total_market_value_pc) AS acpp_total_market_value_pc
        FROM lt_final
        GROUP BY
          business_date, /* , fiscal_date */
          pool_name,
          investment_structure_level_01,
          investment_structure_level_02,
          external_reporting_dm_em,
          external_reporting_region,
          external_reporting_country,
          external_reporting_assetmix,
          business_date_string,
          year_month,
          is_month_end,
          is_fiscalyear_end,
          external_reporting_dm_em_region,
          external_reporting_currency
      ) AS lt_agg
      CROSS JOIN TABLE(EXPLODE(INPUT => ARRAY['bCPP', 'aCPP'])) AS lt_agg_unpivot(seq, "key", "path", index, account_name, this)
    )
    WHERE
      total_market_value_pc IS NOT NULL AND total_market_value_pc != 0
  )
  SELECT
    *
  FROM lt_final_agg
) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

WITH listed_re_mp AS (
  SELECT
    business_date,
    model_portfolio,
    model_portfolio_name
  FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
  WHERE
    NOT model_portfolio_name LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
    AND NOT model_portfolio_name LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
    AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
    AND (
      InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
      AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
      AND NOT model_portfolio IN ('RIRELCP')
      OR model_portfolio IN ('')
    )
    AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-05-17' AS DATE)
), latest_trans AS (
  SELECT
    trans.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
      ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions AS trans
  WHERE
    trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
    AND trans.business_transaction_code IN (
      'Sell',
      'CASell',
      'SellInternal',
      'Buy',
      'CABuy',
      'BuyInternal',
      'CapRed',
      'Exchange Offer',
      'Dividend',
      'Rights Distribution',
      'GenCost'
    )
    AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-05-17' AS DATE)
), latest_finance_trans AS (
  SELECT
    fin.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
      ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions AS fin
  WHERE
    fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
    AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
    AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
    AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
)
